individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot of n=141 individual samples; each marker is one measurement, marginal histograms show the raw distribution.
Scatter plot type (one marker per cell line/reporter with s.d. error bars); scatter plots are exempt from requiring overlaid raw points.
Line/density plots of fitted gamma/normal distributions; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Box plots with individual replicate values (Per2-Luc/Bmal1-Luc dots) overlaid on each box.
Polar histograms display a probability distribution of phase differences, a distribution-type plot that does not require individual point overlay.
Polar histogram showing subtype-averaged probability distribution; distribution plot exempt from individual point overlay.
A single illustrative example line/fit trace, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual points.
Scatter plot with one marker per sample (n=117) and fit-uncertainty error bars; scatter plots are exempt.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot of individual samples with marginal histograms; no error bars are shown.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars shown on scatter points are defined in the caption as mean +/- s.d.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box edges, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
Polar histogram bars show probability, no error bars present.
Single illustrative trace with fitted curve, no error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars on the scatter points are explicitly defined in the caption as s.d. of fitted parameters.
